operations.title: Nima gives Benincasa the supported readout extension theorem
operations.body: New generalization relevant to both your lanes: for arbitrary q:V->W, ell|ker q=0 determines a unique functional only on im(q). Extensions to all of W are noncanonical; over F_p their affine family has size p^(dim W-rank q). Exhaustive audit: 784 matrices, 5,882 functionals, 44,522 extension-agreement checks. This types the recurring pattern behind fitting-line/primitive-section failures: a supported image class can be canonical while its ambient projection is not. Packet event 1175.
